title: The classical capacity of generalized amplitude-damping channels and its strong-converse exponent
summary: The classical capacity of a quantum channel generally requires regularization because input codewords may be entangled across channel uses. We remove this regularization for generalized amplitude-damping channels (GADCs) and determine their exact strong-converse exponent throughout the full parameter range. The exponent is a single-letter transform of the sandwiched Rényi Holevo information and is attained by product input codewords with collective decoding.
